class_name: 許可-許可-テケッコウ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: it is quite all right to; that will do
patterns.usage_note: Grants permission: 〜てもけっこうです tells the listener that doing the thing is acceptable (鉛筆でも結構です, 欠席なさっても結構です). 結構 grants from the position of the one entitled to grant it, so it runs from staff to customer or senior to junior; speaking upward, ask 〜てもよろしいでしょうか instead. 結構です standing alone is normally a polite refusal, but inside the 〜ても frame it reads as permission.

examples.ruby: 申込書[もうしこみしょ]の記入[きにゅう]は鉛筆[えんぴつ]でも結構[けっこう]です。
examples.english: You're welcome to fill in the application form in pencil.

examples.ruby: ご都合[つごう]が悪[わる]ければ、明日[あす]は欠席[けっせき]なさっても結構[けっこう]です。
examples.english: If it doesn't suit you, you may certainly skip tomorrow's session.

examples.ruby: 見本[みほん]は一[ひと]つお持[も]ち帰[かえ]りいただいても結構[けっこう]です。
examples.english: Please feel free to take one of the samples home with you.
